class: Education cards cannot resolve explicit school details or expand to the saved degree count
symptom: ADP Education History stopped at Country and Graduated?, and only one of two saved degrees had a card. Its City showed the home city; the exact earlier write path for that value remains unconfirmed.
site: Church Mutual ADP application 548 Education History, saved page_35 and supervised continuation 26 October 2026
root_cause: Education records had no structured school location/completion facts, country was deliberately unsupported and graduated wording had no resolver. Inline card expansion supported only work records, excluding education.
why_tests_missed: Existing education tests covered schools, majors and dates but no explicit school location/completion detail dictionaries; inline expansion tests covered employment only.
fix: Add school-matched profile education_details and resolve only explicit city/state/country/graduated facts from the matching degree. Extend bounded inline expansion to the saved education count and reuse adapter-aware mapping after Add. Correct the observed City from source-resume facts during supervision; do not claim its earlier write path is proven.
prevention: Test complete degree cards, require explicit institution-specific facts and compare card counts with saved history. Never substitute residence data for a school location.
